function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "Because of the strong confounding between arm and severity (all severe patients are in treatment arm), a raw difference in proportions is invalid and would be biased. To estimate the treatment effect correctly, we compute the response rate difference within each severity stratum (mild, moderate, severe) and then combine them using standardisation (using the overall distribution of severity in the sample as the reference). This gives a valid estimate of the average treatment effect across the population, adjusting for severity. This is the only correct way to answer the question given the non-random assignment."}
